rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
fused form containing siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam joined by sandhi; expresses attainment of powers as the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The eight are included in this teaching.
The attainment of siddhis is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: The root Kaula consists in the eight together with the attainment of siddhis.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'eight' is not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the eight, along with the attainment of siddhis, constitute the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
